tei:div.tei:p: 521)༄༅/ zab gter dbang gi 'don 'khrigs gsal ba'i me long skal bzang 'jug ngogs bzhugs// 522)

chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod dang*/ mkha' 'gro'i thugs thig sogs kyi dbang yongs rdzogs bskur ba'i rim pa la/ thog mar gnas gzhi yo byad sogs legs par grub rjes/ nyin dang po sta gon la/ stegs khebs ldan gyi khar tshom bu lnga bkod pa'i steng du sgrub gtor dang*/ sman raka gtor gsum nyer spyod sogs dang*/ logs bde bar dkar bgegs gnyis kyang bshams/ bdag bskyed cha ga bsnyen bstod yan song mthar/ gzhi ma gang yin pa'i sa der sa lha'i dkar gtor dang*/ rdul tshon grub na thig tshon thig skud rnam lngas bskor ba can bshams/ ma grub na ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor la bstegs te las gang byed 523) kyi sngon 'gro las/ sa chog la 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ hūm̐: rang nyid rta mchog he ru ka sogs nas thig gdab mjug gi dz+nyā na ma dha hū: yan grub mthar/ dkyil 'khor bshams bkod sogs bya'o/ de nas lha sta gon la/ maṇ+ḍal yid du 'ong bar dri bzang gis thig le lha grangs ltar bkod pa'i steng du/ tshom bu rnams lha sngags kyis bkod de mañji'i khar bzhag ste/ lha sngags kyis mchod cing bstod sgrub bya/ bum pa sta gon la/ yungs kar gyis bgegs bskrad/ gu gul bdug chus bshal/ bum pa'i sum gnyis rgyun 'bab kyi chus bkang nas bum rdzas nyer lngas bcud ldan du bya/ mgul chings lha'i sku mdog dang bstun te/ kha rgyan rdo rje gzungs thag sogs legs par byas la/ dbus kyi bum pa mañji khar bshams/ dbang rnams kyi rkang grangs dang bstun pa'i bum pa gzhan rnams phyogs bzhi sogs skabs gang bder 'bru tshom gyi khar bzhag rnam rgyal gyi bum pa sgrub thabs bdud 524) rtsi'i zil mas bsgrubs nas mchod bstod dang bum lha 'od du bya'o/ ༈ sngon du sta gon dang*/ dbang yongs rdzogs bskur tshar rjes dkyil 'khor ma bsdus nas dbang rnams bskur dgos byung na/ sa thig lha dang bum pa sta gon sogs mi dgos gsungs/

mchan/ gang ltar yin yang*/ smin byed dbang gi sta gon las/ khrus bum/ dung chu/ dri bzang chu/ so shing*/ srung skud/ ku sha sogs bsgrub dgos so/ slob ma sta gon la/ slob bu sgo drung du 'khod cing*/ dbang gi lhan thabs bcas/ hūm̐ hrīḥ bde gshegs rgyal ba sogs nas grus dag bgegs bskrad srung 'khor song mthar/ sta gon smin grol lam bzang las/ gsol gdab ni/ kyai: sgo skyong khro bo sogs nas/ smin par bya: bar ro/ de nas slob ma gral du 'khod la/ skyabs rje las 'brel rtsal gyi gter byon gu ru'i thugs sgrub las/ bla mas 'di skad brjod/ 'o/ skal pa dang ldan pa'i slob bu sogs nas skye mched byin brlab mjug ga ི snying gar bzhugs par bsam mo: yan 'dzud mthar/ sta gon gzhung las/ so shing*/ srung skud/ ku sha rnams gtad cing bkra shis/ bsngo smon/ mchod bstod/ bshags pa/ bsngo smon/ bsdu rim/ bkra shis sogs kyis mtha' brgyan no/ ༈ nyin gnyis par/ hūm̐ hrīḥ ma lus sems can sogs nas 525) sku gsum gsol 'debs dang*/ bsam lhun che chung ci rigs/ skyes phreng gsol 'debs/ skye ba kun tu sogs/ spyi gces sngon 'gro las/ bsang chu dang mchod rdzas byin brlab/ gnas dang mchod pa'i sogs/ rigs 'dus gsol 'debs dang*/ skyabs yul bskyed pa bsdus la/ las byang che ba rnams kyis bsgrub dgos pas/ thog mar rig 'dus kyi sgrub thabs yid bzhin gyi nor bu las/ skyabs sems/ yan bdun/ maṇ+ḍal/ tshogs zhing 'od zhu/ dkar bgegs zur gsal/ rang gzhung gi bka' bsgo sogs nas gzhung bzhin bstod bshags yan song mthar/ bh+rūm̐ badz+ra phaṭaḥ kyis 'dzab khang dbye ba kun la 'gres/ 'dzab dang*/ bsnyen pa nye bsten gnyis la stong rtsa bzla/ 'dir bum pa bsgrubs nas/ rtsa sngags la bum sngags btags pa ci 'grub/ sgrub 'dzab dang*/ sgrub sngags lnga brgya/ las sbyor 'dzab dang*/ hrī ma ha ri sogs/ cung zad bzlas mthar/

sid+dhi sum brgya grub mthar/ las bzhi'i sham dang*/ rtsa gsum rgyal ba'i sogs/ dbyangs gsal/ yig brgya/ rten snying*/ 'dod gsol/ gzhung gi mchod bstod dang*/ bum bstod/ bum lha 'od zhu/ dge bsngo bcas grub mthar/ 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi sgrub thabs shes rab nyi ma'am/ 'jam dpal rtsa sgrub 526) bsdus pa shes rab blo 'phel gang rung gi bdag mdun bum gsum gong bzhin bsgrub dgos tshul kun la 'gres so/ thugs chen/ rdor sems/ rta mgrin/ phur pa/ khro lod rnams rang rang gi gzhung ltar bsgrub par byas/ khro lod kyi las sbyor gyi mjug tu/ las bum bsgrub mthar/ mchod bstod/ las bum bstod pa/ dge bsngos bcas 'grub mthar/ dregs pa rnam gsum gyi srog dbang bskur tshe/ gsol mchod 'dir bya dgos/ de nas bshags pa bskang ba'i lung byang*/ rdzas bskang bsdus pa/ tshogs kyi byin brlab/ spyan 'dren/ bdud rtsi 'bul ba/ tshogs mchod mjug tu bskang ba 'dzud/ bshags pa/ mtshams sbyar gyi tshogs 'gugs/ bsgral bstabs/ gnam phud mjug tu/ rig 'dzin bla ma'i dkyil 'khor sogs/ bdag dbang la/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ rig 'dus bum pa dang*/ sku tsaka sogs kyis/ bdag dbang ye shes sgo 'byed kyis bdag 'jug blang nas/ dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma sogs/ las bum 'od zhu/ yig brgya/ ༈ de nas dbang rnams bskur ba la/ thog mar slob ma rnams kyi sgrub khang phyi rol nas sgo zhus bya/ lhan thabs las/ hūm̐ hrīḥ bde gshegs rgyal ba sogs kyis kha chab 'gyed/ 527) rta mgrin bskyed pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra kro ta h+ya sogs/ 'khor lor gyur/ sgrub thabs las/ bka' bsgo/ hūm̐ hrīḥ bdag nyid dpal chen sogs/ phyir dengs shig: lhan thabs las/ na mo/ rje btsun rtsa ba sogs/ ta ya phaṭaḥ rtsa sngags dang*/ hūm̐ bzhi/ drag sngags kyis bskrad pa'i dus su/ slon bu rnams sgrub khang nang du 'byon dgos pa chos 'di yi phyag bzhes yin/ sgrub thabs las/ bsrung 'khor/

hūm̐ hrīḥ ka dag spros bral sogs/ rak+ṣa hūm̐: lhan thabs las/ ces brjod pas sogs/ rak+ṣa bhūm̐: lo rgyus/ 'o/ nam mkha' dang sogs/ gdan drangs pa'i nang nas/ zur gsal las/ da lan gyi skabs su sogs/ zhu ba la/ lhan thabs las/ dkyil 'khor bsgrub cing sogs/ mdzod/ maṇ+ḍal rgyas pa 'bul/ rig 'dus dbang mchog las/ gsol ba gdab ni/ gsol/ kye+ai ma: bla ma rdo rje sogs nas slob ma lha bskyed kyi/ khyab bdag mchog: sgrub thabs las/ o rgyan mtsho skyes sogs/ klong na gzhugs: bsdu tshe 'og gi gnas sum rdo rje'i sogs nas spyan 'dren mjug gi hrīng hrīng dzaḥ bar dang*/ dbang gzhung las/ ye shes pa'i lha tshogs sogs nas/ bum dbang 528) mjug gi ṣiñca oṃ: lhan thabs las/ mdun bskyed kyi sogs/ mos pa gyis: dbang gzhung las/ rigs bdag gtad la/ hūm̐: sangs rgyas kun gyi sogs nas/ sa sher dbang mjug gi bzhag pa yin no: rig pa'i rtsal dbang la/ don dbang 'brel tshad sogs/ mngon byung zhu ba'i phyir maṇ+ḍal phul/ zhes kha bsgyur ba kun la 'gres/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul mthar/ gsol gdab ni/ hoḥ bla ma rdo rje sogs nas/ slar ma ldog cig: yan song rjes/ dbang gzhung las/ 'o/ rigs kyi bu rnams sogs nas/ bka' dbang mjug gi sarba sid+dhi hrīḥ tshogs pa kun la dbang rdzas rnams 'grim mthar/ lha gang yin gyi bkra shis tshig bzhi re brjod de kun la 'gres so/ 'jam dpal gyi dbang bskur ba la/ sgrub thabs las/ chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod sogs/ shes rab nyi ma'i rtsal dbang zab mo zhu ba'i phyir maṇ+ḍal phul/ slob mas/ sa gzhi spos chus sogs/ āḥhūm̐: dbang bzhi rgyal thabs spyi blugs las/ gsol gdab ni/ e ma: gsang sngags bla med sogs/ slob ma lha bskyed skabs su kha bsgyur ni/ slob ma rnams 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi lha ru gsal ba'i sogs nas/ spyan 'dren skabs/ 529)stong gsal ma 'gags 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi lhaḥ sogs gsol gdab skabs/ bu rnams la:

'jam dpal dbyangs kyi dngos gzhi'i dbang: bum dbang skabs/ bum pa ru: 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi dkyil 'khor lhun gyis grub: sogs/ ṣiñca hūm̐: lha dbang don bsdus la/ hūm̐ hrīḥ snang ba yangs pa'i sogs nas/ bka' dbang mjug ga ི sarba a bhi ṣiñca hrīḥ dbang rdzas rnams 'grim/ bkra shis tshig bzhi brjod/ 'gro 'dul 'phags pa'i rtsa dbang ye shes snang 'byed/ rdor sems dbang bzhi rgyal thabs spyi blugs/ yi dam dbang chen yab yum gyi rtsa dbang byin rlabs gter mdzod/ phur sgrub bdud las rnam rgyal gyi rtsa dbang dngos grub snye ma/ khro lod kyi dbang bzhi rgyal thabs spyi blugs rnams kyi dbang yongs rdzogs 530) mthar/ tshogs kyi drangs pa blang zhing*/ dpon slob rnams kyi tshogs la rol/ lhag ma byin brlabs/ rtsa gdangs kyis/ lhag ma/ pheṃ bh+yo: dpal gyi bka' nyan sogs/ khā hiḥ mchod rol/ tshogs mchod phul ba'i sogs/ lhan thabs las mtha' rten gtad pa/ hūm̐ hrīḥ sngon tshe ston pa' ི sogs/ 'bul snyam pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ phag mo'i dbang mjug gi sku drin gzob pa/ bla ma lha yi sogs/ sa tshul bzhin bsgrub: lan gsum/ lhan thabs las/ de nas skal ldan rnams kyi rnams kyi sogs/ bstim bar gyur/ ye dharma sogs/ rigs 'dus tshogs mchod las/ hūm̐ hrīḥ mdzad pa mtha' yas sogs/ bkra shis shog: bstan pa'i dpal gyur sogs/ gnas 'dir nyin mo sogs nas/ gyur cig lhan thabs las/ de ltar dbang thob sogs/ bar zhu: bsod nams 'di yis sogs bsngo smon ci rigs mthar/ rjes rim gtor 'gugs mthar/ bskul ba/ chad tho byin brlabs/ chad tho/ brtan ma byin brlab/ brtan ma/ bro 'gugs/ bro mnan/ gtor gzhong btegs pa/ mchod bstod/ dngos grub/ bshags 531) pa/ bsngo smon/ rten bzhugs/ bsdu ldang*/ bkra shis bsngo smon ci rigs kyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o/ ༈ nyin gsum par/ hūm̐ hrīḥ ma lus sems can sogs nas gong bzhin rigs 'dus kyi tshab tu/

mkha' 'gro dgongs 'dus kyi gzhung bsrangs shing bdag mdun bum gsum bsgrub tshul rnams sngar nyin ltar bya'o/ de nas rdo rje phag mo/ ma sgyud gsang ba ye shes/ thugs thig mtsho rgyal thugs sgrub/ gsang mdzod mtsho rgyal/ rje btsun sgrol ma/ rig byed lha mo rnams kyi bsgrub gzhung bsrangs nas/ bdag mdun bum gsum bcas bsgrubs mthar/ tshogs bskang gnam phud yan grub rjes/ bdag 'jug blang*/ sgo zhus mi dgos/ lhan thabs las/ kha chab blangs pa song nas/ 'o/ nam mkha' dang sogs/ chos kyi rim pa'ang*/ mkha' 'gro dgongs 'dus lo rgyus las/ dpal mchog dang po sogs/ dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa sogs nas lhan thabs ltar dang*/ mkha' 'gro gsang ba 'dus pa'i don dbang skal ldan rjes 'dzin dang*/ lhan thabs gnyis sbrags nas dbang yongs rdzogs bskur mthar/ rdo rje phag mo'i smin byed gsang ba'i dbang bzhi thun min nges don mkha' 'gro'i thugs bcud las/ gsol gdab ni/ e ma: 532)bde chen ye shes sogs nas/ gta' ru bzung: sngon 'gro spyi gces gab pa mngon phyung las/ na mo: sangs rgyas chos dang sogs nas/ cit+ta badz+ra sa ma ya: bar dang*/ gzhung gi me tog gtad pa sogs nas/ thun min gsang pa'i dbang bskur skabs kyi chos 'byung gtad pa'i mjug ga ི tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: 'og gi gsol gdab/ kyai/ gsang sngags 'dzin mdzad sogs nas/ phyag rgya ru bsgoms shig: gong gi hrīḥ mi mo brgyad gnyis sogs/ bskur bar bgyi: 'og gi rig ma sbyin pa/ āḥ skye med chos sku sogs/ mu dra a bhi ṣiñca āḥ āḥ.āḥ mtsho rgyal gsang dbang shes rab rtsa 'byed kyi ngo sprod las/ e ma: gson dang sogs nas/ rdo rje 'chang dngos 'grub: bar dang dbang gzhung las/ sin+dhu ra dang li khri thogs la/ hūm̐ hrīḥ gsang chen ḍāk+ki sogs nas gzhung ltar ro/ ma rgyud gsang ba ye shes kyi dbang bzhi rgyal thabs spyi blugs bskur/ mkha' 'gro'i don dbang dngos grub sgo 'byed byin rlabs bcud ster gyi lha bskyed skabs kyi/

med par gsal: 'og gi de ltar gsal pa'i sogs nas gzhung ltar bya'o/ bde chen mtsho rgyal ma'i gsang dbang skal ldan rjes 'dzin gyi lha bskyed kyi/ klong du gsal: 'og gi lha rnams kyi gnas gsum sogs gzhung ltar ro/ rje btsun 'phags ma'i 533) rjes gnang gter gyi bum bzang gzhung ltar ro/ rig byed lha mo'i smin byed dbang gi 'jug ngogs dngos grub snye ma rnams kyi dbang bskur yongs rdzogs mthar/ tshogs kyi drangs pa blang*/ lhag ma 'don/ dbang gi mtha' rten rdzas rtags sna bdun rnams mtsho rgyal dbang gzhung ltar dang*/ dam tshig khas blang sogs nas bsngo smon yan lhan thabs bzhin bya/ yang na dbang gi bkra shis rdzas rtags mjug tu/ tshogs kyi drang ba dang*/ lhag ma byas mthar/ bsngo smon 'don kyang rung ngo/ dregs pa rnam gsum gyi gsol kha 'dir bya/ rjes rim bskul ba chad brtan sogs nas las mtha' rgyas su bya'o/ ༈ yang dbang rnams yongs rdzogs nyin gcig la bskur dgos pa byung na/ 'jam dpal/ rdor sems/ khro lod/ mkha' spyod ma/ bde chen dkar mo gang rung gcig la/ dbang bzhi rgyal thabs spyi blugs tshar gcig bskur bas 'thus par bya zhing*/ dbang gzhan ma rnams cung zad mgyogs bsdus su bskur nas nyin gcig gis rdzogs par byed pa'i phyag srol yang yod do/ ༈ bsgrub tshul rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum yod pas/ rgyas par bdag mdun las byang che ba rnams 'don mthar bsnyen bstod mthar/ gtso bum bsgrub cing*/ bum sngags bzla dus rtsa sngags rnams kyi swā hā med pa'i mjug tu/ 534)sarba pañca sogs sbyar ba kun la 'gres/ bum lha mchod bstod 'od zhu/ las bum bsgrub cing mchod bstod 'od zhu/ bdag dbang rgyas pa dbang rang gzhung ltar blang dgos la/ bsdus tshe ye shes sgo 'byed ltar bya'o/ 'bring por bdag mdun bum gsum bsgrub tshul gong ltar bya'o/ shin tu bsdu na bdag mdun bum gsum stabs gcig tu dmigs pas lde kha bsgyur nas bsgrub na'ang chog pa dang*/

rta mgrin/ phur pa/ mtsho rgyal sogs kyis rtsa sgrub kyis bsgrub na rung tsam yin no/ ༈ dbang rnams kyi skabs su skyabs sems yan bdun rnams rang rang gi gzhung ltar dang*/ med pa rnams la gab pa mngon byung ltar bya dgos/ slob ma lha bskyed skabs su rgyas par lha bskyed yongs rdzogs 'don/ bsdus tshe 'khor rnams dor chog dkyil 'khor mthong ba bstan pa'i dus su dkyil tsaka slob dpon gyis thogs dgos/ rig tsaka gtad dus dar gyis smad dkris byed pa phyag bzhes yin/ gong gi dbang rnams bskur skabs dbang rdzas re re bzhin du bla sprul gtso bo rnams la rdor slob kyis 'grims nas/ dbang tshan re'i mjug tu 'tshogs pa kun la rdo rje slob dpon gyis gtso bum bsnams nas de'i rjes su dbang rdzas gzhan rnams go rim ma 'chol bar/ rab dbang lung rnams

535) sngon du thob zin pa'o/ min kyang de'i skabs su dbang thob pa'i bla sprul rnams kyis 'grims dgos pa dang*/ dbang bsgrub skabs sgrub mi rnams dbang lung sngon du rdzogs zin pa zhig nges bar gal che ba dang*/ bsnyen bsgrub las sbyor gyi sngags grangs bzung skabs/ sgrub mi ci yod rnam gyi grangs ni brtsi chog pa sogs phyag bzhes 'khrul med yin no/ zhes zab gter dbang gi las 'grigs 'di nyid mtshan brjod par dka' na'ang*/ don gyis slad du smos na/ bdag cag 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon dam pa kun bzang bde skyong chos nyid dbang mo'i zhal snga nas 'di ltar bri rgyu'i bkas gnang ba thob pa la brten nas/ nyid kyi zhal gsungs rnams gzhir bzhag cing gter chen bla ma yab sras kyi phyag bzhes dang cung zad go bstun te/ zab chos kyi cha rkyen du slob 'bangs yongs kyi tha shal pa nye gnas tshul khrims rdo rjes nag 'gros su bkod pa'o/ dge'o// 536)
